requirements.title: Reduction functions collapse one or all dimensions and may use DIM
requirements.definition: Reduction functions reduce rank by collapsing one dimension or all dimensions, usually producing a scalar, and have a DIM argument that can specify the reduced dimension.

pending.reduction-functions-collapse-dimensions: Use SUM or another exact reduction on a rank-two array with DIM omitted, DIM=1, and DIM=2; assert exact shape/value differences.
pending.dim-argument-specifies-reduced-dimension: Use SUM or another exact reduction on a rank-two array with DIM omitted, DIM=1, and DIM=2; assert exact shape/value differences.

requirements.title: Reduction combines selected elements with simple or specialized operations
requirements.definition: Dimension reduction usually combines selected elements with a simple operation such as addition or MAX, with more sophisticated reductions such as COUNT and MAXLOC also provided.

pending.reduction-combines-selected-elements: Use exact SUM/PRODUCT/MAXVAL/COUNT/MAXLOC inputs with nondefault selected elements and a mutation that changes only a selected element.
pending.specialized-reductions-provided: Use exact SUM/PRODUCT/MAXVAL/COUNT/MAXLOC inputs with nondefault selected elements and a mutation that changes only a selected element.

review_rationale: Source registration for Clause 16 general text, 16 through 16.8: intrinsic procedure classes and general rules, the bit and numeric models, atomic and collective subroutines, and the standard generic and specific name tables (batch178). This opens Clause 16. Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; round 1 found conditional pending plans for the atomic and collective STAT semantics, now resolved into explicit decisions: image-dependent facets are out of scope for single-image fixtures by user decision, and the 'any other error' STAT values have no portable oracle because such an error cannot be induced portably. C1601 and C1602 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
